randolist

Reproducible, blinded block randomisation lists for clinical trials, following the OUCRU SOP PR-BST-DM-001 Creating Randomisation Lists (v008).

randolist is a revision of the legacy createRandoListNew.R. For the same seed and settings it produces the same list, but it

  • fixes two bugs when patient numbers are permuted (n.block_permute): one could duplicate patient numbers, the other made the function fail,
  • restores your random number settings and refuses to run without a seed,
  • validates its inputs and refuses non-unique randomisation numbers,
  • adds helpers that enforce the SOP’s dummy/final switch, file naming and verification of the list.

The guide: Creating a reproducible, blinded randomisation list.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("TranHung93/randomization_list", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Example 

library(randolist)

DUMMY      <- TRUE         # pharmacist: FALSE
DUMMY_SEED <- 20261104
SEED       <- DUMMY_SEED   # pharmacist: generate_seed()
check_final_setup(DUMMY, SEED, DUMMY_SEED)

rl <- createRandoList(
  nPat = 200, arm_names = dummy_arm_names(c("Dex", "Pla"), DUMMY),
  blocklength = c(4, 6), blocklength_prob = c(0.75, 0.25), seed = SEED
)
check_rando_list(rl)
write_rando_list(rl, dir = "<study folder>", study = "24EI", dummy = DUMMY)

A full study script template: system.file("templates", "rando_list_template.R", package = "randolist").

Repository layout

Path Content
R/ Package code
inst/legacy/createRandoListNew.R The original function, unchanged; reference for the tests
tests/testthat/ Tests, including side-by-side comparison with the legacy code
vignettes/ The guide
sop/ SOP PR-BST-DM-001, workshop slides, original folder README

Validation

GitHub Actions runs R CMD check on Windows, macOS and Linux (R release, previous release and devel). The tests generate lists with the legacy and the new code from the same seeds and require them to be identical, apart from the documented bug fixes.
